High School Queen () is an upcoming South Korean television series starring Kim Se-jeong. Based on Naver webtoon of the same name by Critie and Nehae, it tells the story of Kim Cheong-ha, a master swordswoman and queen from the Joseon era, who finds herself reborn as Park Da-jin, a high school student in modern times. Armed with ancient fighting skills, she takes on bullies.
Synopsis
Cast and characters
* Kim Se-jeong as Kim Cheong-ha
Production
On February 24, 2026, Studio Dragon was reported to have signed a planning and development contract with Jaedam Media for a drama adaptation of Naver webtoon High School Queen. Two days later, Shin Ye-eun was reportedly set to lead the series as Kim Cheong-ha, who reincarnates as Park Da-jin. However, Kim Se-jeong was ultimately selected to portray Kim Cheong-ha in April 2026.
